scope_reason: The paper examines urban heat island (UHI) events, measured as satellite land surface temperature during the hottest April window, and their relation to urban growth.

scope_span.evidence_text: We provided a methodology to assess the impact of the fast growth of urban centers on the increase in the intensity of UHI events

claims.restatement: During April UHI events 2001-2021, land surface temperature rose about 0.34 °C per year in Bangalore's urban settlement areas versus 0.14 °C per year in non-urban areas.

concept.value: land surface temperature during the UHI events (MODIS LST, highest 8-day April window)

geography.value: Bangalore (urban settlement areas vs non-urban areas)

evidence.evidence_text: We further found land surface temperature, on average, increased by about 0.34 • C per year in urban settlement areas of Bangalore during the UHI events of April 2001 and 2021, in contrast to 0.14 • C per year in non-urban areas.

claims.note: These rates differ from the modelled slopes in claim 251972000-C2 (0.247 vs 0.056 °C/yr); the paper does not reconcile them.

claims.restatement: A linear mixed-effect model gave a mean modelled LST trend of 0.247 °C per year at urbanised sites versus 0.056 °C per year at non-urbanised sites.

support_span.evidence_text: The present study aims to assess the impacts of Bangalore city's urbanization over 20 years
This study particularly focuses on the relationship between urban growth and UHI events during the April months from 2001 to 2021.

evidence.evidence_text: It was observed that the mean-modeled LST as a function of the above parameters shows an increasing trend with a slope of 0.247 • C per year in contrast to 0.056 • C per year in non-urbanized areas.

claims.note: See note on 251972000-C1: the two pairs of rates are not reconciled in the paper.

claims.restatement: Comparing three April UHI temperature events, such events increased in intensity by 3.25 °C from 2001 to 2021.

support_span.evidence_text: The present study aims to assess the impacts of Bangalore city's urbanization over 20 years

evidence.evidence_text: Based on the comparison of three UHI temperature events, we observed that such events over the years in the same month have increased in intensity (3.25 • C from 2001 to 2021).
